## What this changes and why

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm test` passes (including the end-to-end job tests)
- [ ] No invented data: any new text, number or example is real or clearly labelled as sample
- [ ] Anything that changes a user's site, sends something out or adds a data source stays behind a human approval
- [ ] New or changed jobs are registered in `src/jobs/index.mjs` and documented in `docs/jobs.md`
- [ ] Workflow template changes keep third-party actions pinned to a full commit SHA and never put untrusted text in `run:`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
